Description: Delegate real work to Copilot, such as creating or updating records or running actions in Business Central.

FeatureName: Add subcontracting suggestions to an existing purchase order
Description: You can add new subcontracting worksheet suggestions to a compatible open purchase order for the same vendor, keeping related work on one order.
GettingStartedSteps: Use a company with the Premium experience and the Subcontracting extension installed and set up. Start with a released production order that has subcontracted work that still needs to be ordered.
Open the Subcontracting Worksheets page and choose the Calculate Subcontracts action. Filter for the relevant production order or operation, then choose OK.
Select a suggestion whose Action Message field is New. Choose the Assign purchase order action and select a compatible open purchase order for the same vendor.
Ensure Accept Action Message is selected for this suggestion. Choose the Carry Out Action Message action, then choose OK.
Open the purchase order you selected and verify the additional subcontracting operation line and its production order and operation links. Supporting component or comment lines can also be present.
